sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that through the work of the lower man, not only is the inner aspect of the upper man revealed, but also the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof, which is above even the light as it is in itself.

translations.translation: And to add,
that according to what was explained above
(section 6)

that this which arose in His will that the drawing down from above should be through arousal from below is because the root of arousal from below is in the Essence of Ein Sof, which is above even the light as it is in itself, before the matter of arousal from below arose in His will,
it can be said,
that in addition to this, that through the work of the lower man the inner aspect of the upper man is revealed, which is one with the simplicity of Ein Sof as it is in the aspect of water
[the light that has a connection to form,
analogous to plain water, that even before one looks into them they are in a manner that it is possible to see in them the face that looks into them],
behold, through the work of the lower man there is also drawn down a revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof, which is above even the light as it is in itself.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section details that the work of refining the animal soul purifies the partitions, connecting the revealed sefiros with the hidden ones, while the work of the soul's heartfelt desire draws down the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof.

translations.translation: And this is,
And behold, the work through which the inner aspect of the upper man is revealed is, in general, the work of refining the animal soul.
For that the revealed sefiros are
(in externality)
like something separate that came into being from the hidden sefiros is because of the partition between the hidden sefiros and the revealed sefiros.
And through the refinement of the animal soul, the partition between that which is above Atzilus
(the hidden sefiros)
and Atzilus
(the revealed sefiros) is refined,
and through this, the revelation of the hidden sefiros is felt in a revealed way within the sefiros of Atzilus,
as explained above, that the faces in the water are those seen by the person.
And to add,
that through the refinement and purification of the animal soul, all the partitions are purified,
and also the purification of the first contraction,
and through this,
the connection of the revealed sefiros with the hidden sefiros is with all the levels within the hidden sefiros,
including also the hidden sefiros that are before the contraction.
And likewise on the other side,
that through the refinement of the animal soul, the partition between Atzilus and BiYA is also purified
[for the primary concealment is through this partition],
and through this the connection of the lower man with the upper man is made.
And the work through which the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof is drawn down is the work that stems from the soul
(which is above being clothed in the body and the animal soul),
which in general is the work of heartfelt desire.
For that through the work of Yisrael the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof is drawn down is because of the virtue of the souls,
that they arose in thought
(as explained above in section 6),
and therefore the drawing down of this revelation is through heartfelt desire.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the innovation of the Giving of the Torah involved two matters: the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof through heartfelt desire, and the nullification of the barrier between upper and lower worlds through refining the animal soul, both of which are prepared for during the Counting of the Omer.

translations.translation: A)
And behold, in the innovation that was innovated at the Giving of the Torah
[the first time,
and likewise at the Giving of the Torah in every year],
there are two matters.
The drawing down and revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof to Yisrael — "I am Hashem your G-d",
and the drawing down of this revelation is through heartfelt desire.
And the nullification of the decree and the barrier between the upper ones and the lower ones,
in all the worlds.
And the drawing down of this revelation is through the refinement of the animal soul.
And therefore during the Counting of the Omer,
which is the preparation for the Giving of the Torah,
both matters must be present,
the refinement of the attributes of the animal soul,
and the love of "with all your might"
(heartfelt desire).
